coverage_gaps: European Medicines Agency and other non-FDA regulator routes are unavailable, limiting direct comparison of international regulatory interpretations.
Dedicated citation-graph and DOI metadata routes are unavailable, so forward-citation and version discovery must rely on PubMed links, identifiers, and author expansion.
Preprint servers and non-PubMed subject indexes are unavailable, which may delay detection of recent or unindexed qualifying evidence.
FDA webpage search may not expose every historical label version or internal review memorandum; document dates and supersession relationships require explicit verification when records are recovered.
The available routes do not guarantee access to full text, supplementary appendices, individual-patient data, or complete protocol and statistical-analysis-plan versions.
A correction or retraction published after 2024-12-31 falls outside the as-of assessment and would require a separately labeled post-cutoff integrity update.
exclusion_criteria: Evidence first made public after 2024-12-31, except a later integrity notice may be logged separately as post-cutoff information without altering the as-of conclusion.
Non-rheumatoid-arthritis studies that cannot inform an FDA class action or a directly relevant mechanistic interpretation of the marketed rheumatoid arthritis indication.
Efficacy-only reports lacking decision-relevant safety outcomes or exposure information.
Preclinical, in vitro, animal, pharmacokinetic-only, and narrative promotional material without clinical safety evidence.
Reports that combine JAK inhibitors without extractable tofacitinib findings, unless they document the scope or rationale of an FDA class-wide action.
Duplicate publications with no additional data, analysis, correction, or version information; their identifiers remain linked to the canonical record.
Unverified summaries, news reports, and secondary webpages when the registry, primary publication, or FDA source is available.
Claims whose population, dose, comparator, outcome definition, or time at risk cannot be determined sufficiently to avoid misleading comparison.
inclusion_criteria: Records available on or before 2024-12-31, with online-first, issue, registry-posting, correction, and regulatory-effective dates recorded separately.
The NCT02092467 registry record, its posted results and history, the primary ORAL Surveillance publication, and directly linked secondary analyses.
FDA safety communications, reviews, and prescribing-information changes that explicitly concern tofacitinib or use ORAL Surveillance as an evidentiary basis.
Studies in rheumatoid arthritis that report comparative or dose-specific cardiovascular, malignancy, thrombosis, pulmonary embolism, or mortality outcomes for tofacitinib.

Qualifying evidence from randomized trials, long-term extensions, postauthorization studies, registries, cohorts, and systematic reviews when population, comparator, dose, follow-up, and outcome definitions are extractable.
Negative, null, conflicting, subgroup, sensitivity, correction, erratum, retraction, and expression-of-concern records relevant to a decision-critical claim.
Human evidence in any language when an English title or abstract permits eligibility assessment; otherwise retain as awaiting translation rather than silently exclude.
Duplicate query hits are retained as query-to-record links, while canonical records are deduplicated by NCT number, PMID, DOI, FDA document identity, and version date.

queries.purpose: Recover the pivotal postauthorization ORAL Surveillance registry record and capture sponsor protocol identifiers, design, eligibility, interventions, outcomes, enrollment, completion dates, results, publications, and update history.
Recover the primary publication and directly linked reports while validating registry, study-name, and sponsor-protocol aliases.
queries.query: ("NCT02092467"[All Fields] OR "ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR "A3921133"[All Fields]) AND (tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR Xeljanz[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Recover FDA materials explicitly linking the required postmarketing trial to regulatory conclusions and actions.
queries.query: site:fda.gov tofacitinib ORAL Surveillance NCT02092467 safety communication

queries.purpose: Identify peer-reviewed rheumatoid arthritis safety evidence across all decision-relevant outcome domains without prematurely restricting study design.
queries.query: ("Arthritis, Rheumatoid"[Mesh] OR "rheumatoid arthritis"[Title/Abstract]) AND ("Tofacitinib"[Mesh] OR tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR Xeljanz[Title/Abstract] OR "CP-690550"[Title/Abstract]) AND (safety[Title/Abstract] OR cardiovascular[Title/Abstract] OR malignan*[Title/Abstract] OR cancer[Title/Abstract] OR thrombo*[Title/Abstract] OR embol*[Title/Abstract] OR mortality[Title/Abstract] OR death[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Find registered tofacitinib rheumatoid arthritis studies reporting relevant safety outcomes and detect linked or potentially competing studies.
queries.query: AREA[ConditionSearch] "Rheumatoid Arthritis" AND AREA[InterventionSearch] (tofacitinib OR Xeljanz OR CP-690550) AND (AREA[OutcomeMeasure] cardiovascular OR AREA[OutcomeMeasure] malignancy OR AREA[OutcomeMeasure] thrombosis OR AREA[OutcomeMeasure] mortality)

queries.purpose: Retrieve FDA safety communications, reviews, labeling documents, and action histories across the four specified safety domains.
queries.query: site:fda.gov (tofacitinib OR Xeljanz) (cardiovascular OR cancer OR malignancy OR thrombosis OR pulmonary embolism OR death OR mortality)

queries.purpose: Confirm primary and secondary estimates for the co-primary cardiovascular and malignancy endpoints, including noninferiority results, confidence intervals, and prespecified analyses.
queries.query: ("ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR "NCT02092467"[All Fields]) AND ("major adverse cardiovascular events"[Title/Abstract] OR MACE[Title/Abstract] OR malignan*[Title/Abstract] OR cancer[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Confirm dose-specific thrombosis, pulmonary embolism, and mortality findings and distinguish adjudicated outcomes from broader adverse-event summaries.
queries.query: ("ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR "NCT02092467"[All Fields]) AND (thrombo*[Title/Abstract] OR "venous thromboembolism"[Title/Abstract] OR "pulmonary embolism"[Title/Abstract] OR mortality[Title/Abstract] OR death*[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Retrieve analyses that qualify absolute or relative risk by age, smoking, baseline cardiovascular disease, and other enrichment factors.
queries.query: ("ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR "NCT02092467"[All Fields]) AND (subgroup*[Title/Abstract] OR smoking[Title/Abstract] OR smoker*[Title/Abstract] OR "65 years"[Title/Abstract] OR "atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease"[Title/Abstract] OR ASCVD[Title/Abstract] OR "risk factor"[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Confirm the date, evidentiary basis, affected JAK inhibitors, and recommended restrictions in the 2021 FDA safety action.
queries.query: site:fda.gov/drugs/drug-safety-and-availability Xeljanz tofacitinib September 2021 heart-related events cancer blood clots death

queries.purpose: Confirm effective boxed-warning language, indications, dose restrictions, and subsequent label state through the as-of cutoff.
queries.query: site:accessdata.fda.gov Xeljanz prescribing information boxed warning cardiovascular malignancy thrombosis mortality 2021 OR 2022 OR 2023 OR 2024

queries.purpose: Recover the earlier thrombosis and mortality signal, interim trial interpretation, and 2019 FDA action for contextual chronology.
queries.query: site:fda.gov Xeljanz tofacitinib pulmonary embolism 10 mg twice daily boxed warning 2019 rheumatoid arthritis

queries.purpose: Revisit all structured registry modules and linked publications to reconcile protocol versions, outcome definitions, analysis populations, dose changes, and reporting dates.
queries.query: AREA[NCTId] NCT02092467 AND AREA[StudyType] INTERVENTIONAL

queries.purpose: Expand through anchor authors and identifiers to locate secondary outcome, subgroup, and methodological reports tied to the pivotal study.
queries.query: ("ORAL Surveillance"[All Fields] OR "NCT02092467"[All Fields] OR "A3921133"[All Fields]) AND (Ytterberg[Author] OR Cohen[Author] OR Curtis[Author] OR Charles-Schoeman[Author])

queries.purpose: Detect corrections, errata, retractions, or expressions of concern affecting anchor or derivative publications and trigger version-specific evidence handling.
queries.query: (("ORAL Surveillance"[All Fields] OR "NCT02092467"[All Fields] OR tofacitinib[Title]) AND (Correction[Publication Type] OR Retracted Publication[Publication Type] OR Retraction of Publication[Publication Type] OR Published Erratum[Publication Type] OR correction[Title] OR erratum[Title] OR retract*[Title] OR "expression of concern"[Title]))

queries.purpose: Identify external observational, registry, and synthesis evidence that supports, narrows, or conflicts with ORAL Surveillance while preserving differences in population and comparator.
queries.query: ("Arthritis, Rheumatoid"[Mesh] OR "rheumatoid arthritis"[Title/Abstract]) AND (tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR Xeljanz[Title/Abstract]) AND ("TNF inhibitor"[Title/Abstract] OR TNFi[Title/Abstract]) AND (observational[Title/Abstract] OR cohort[Title/Abstract] OR registry[Title/Abstract] OR meta-analysis[Publication Type]) AND (cardiovascular[Title/Abstract] OR malignan*[Title/Abstract] OR thrombo*[Title/Abstract] OR mortality[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Find methodological critiques and evidence concerning applicability beyond the cardiovascular-risk-enriched trial population.
queries.query: ("ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR "NCT02092467"[All Fields]) AND (bias[Title/Abstract] OR limitation*[Title/Abstract] OR confound*[Title/Abstract] OR generalizab*[Title/Abstract] OR "risk enrichment"[Title/Abstract] OR interpretation[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Capture late publications, updated analyses, and integrity notices through the as-of date, applying the cutoff again after retrieval to handle online-first and indexing ambiguity.
queries.query: (("ORAL Surveillance"[All Fields] OR "NCT02092467"[All Fields] OR (tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] AND "rheumatoid arthritis"[Title/Abstract])) AND (cardiovascular[Title/Abstract] OR malignan*[Title/Abstract] OR cancer[Title/Abstract] OR thrombo*[Title/Abstract] OR mortality[Title/Abstract] OR correction[Title] OR retract*[Title])) AND ("2023/01/01"[Date - Publication] : "2024/12/31"[Date - Publication])

queries.purpose: Check registry changes and posted results through the cutoff and distinguish study dates from registry-update dates.
queries.query: NCT02092467 | Last Update Posted through 2024-12-31

queries.purpose: Identify FDA revisions, clarifications, or superseding actions through 2024-12-31 and preserve each document's effective date.
queries.query: site:fda.gov (tofacitinib OR Xeljanz) (safety communication OR boxed warning OR prescribing information OR labeling) after:2021-12-01 before:2025-01-01

question_frame: Safety-focused PECO as of 2024-12-31: adults aged 50 years or older with rheumatoid arthritis, at least one additional cardiovascular risk factor, and inadequate response to methotrexate; exposure to marketed-dose tofacitinib 5 mg twice daily or 10 mg twice daily; active comparator tumor necrosis factor inhibitor; outcomes of major adverse cardiovascular events, malignancy excluding nonmelanoma skin cancer, venous and arterial thrombosis, pulmonary embolism, and all-cause or cause-specific mortality. The assessment will link ORAL Surveillance to NCT02092467, its primary publication, secondary analyses, and dated FDA communications and labeling actions, while identifying qualifying evidence and corrections, expressions of concern, or retractions that alter evidence handling.
stop_rules: Complete every planned route and wave, recording the exact query, execution date, cutoff handling, result count, and provider version when available.

Do not stop until NCT02092467, the primary ORAL Surveillance publication, the 2019 thrombosis action, the 2021 FDA safety communication, and the resulting boxed-warning or prescribing-information change are recovered and cross-linked.
Require outcome coverage for cardiovascular events, malignancy, thrombosis or pulmonary embolism, and mortality, with both relative estimates and absolute event information sought for each domain.
Require at least one dedicated challenge search for correction, erratum, retraction, expression of concern, null or conflicting evidence, and applicability limitations.
Continue alias expansion whenever a sentinel anchor is missing, including ORAL Surveillance, NCT02092467, A3921133, Xeljanz, and CP-690550.
Stop citation, author, and linked-record expansion after two consecutive completed expansion passes add no new decision-relevant eligible record or material version change.
Stop when further retrieval from the three available routes cannot change the safety conclusion, its certainty, the FDA chronology, or the stated population and dose qualifications.

If a planned route is unavailable or a time or record budget is exhausted, stop that branch only after documenting the limitation and any unrecovered anchor; do not infer absence of evidence from failed retrieval.
Freeze the canonical evidence set at the as-of cutoff, preserve all query-to-record links, and rerun identifier checks to confirm exact registry-publication-regulatory linkage before synthesis.
